economy: US dollar 103.4 (+0.19% today, +1.69% this week): a stronger dollar usually pushes gold down.
US 10-year yield 5.15% (+14 bp today): higher yields make gold, which pays no interest, less attractive.
VIX (fear index) 19.3 (+5% today) · S&P 500 -0.37%: normal risk mood.
Gold is moving against the dollar and yields today: that move is driven by something else (flows, safe-haven demand) and can reverse.

Fed Chairman Warsh Speaks at 00:00 GMT+7: Federal Reserve. A tougher (hawkish) tone or fewer cuts → dollar up → gold down. A softer (dovish) tone → gold up. The press conference often moves gold more than the decision.
history_note: Levels like this held about half the time over 2 years of data, so this is a place to watch, not a trade on its own.
